topic: Analytics dashboard improvements and feature decisions
summary_markdown:
Several UI/UX improvements were discussed for the analytics platform. These include standardizing number formatting (replacing spaces with dots, e.g., 10.000.000), adding a hover-activated button for field details, and implementing filters (City, region) in the Analytics section.

For the Planner view, it was decided that audience data should be displayed ranked from highest to lowest across metrics like Total Traffic, ROTS, and VAC.

Regarding date filtering, the ability to select a specific date must remain, even if real-time data is hidden by default. The team confirmed hiding real-time data from the graph but maintaining the date picker functionality.
decisions: Number formatting standardizing: Replace spaces with dots (e.g., 10.000.000).
Analytics section to include hover details and filters (City, region).
Planner view audience display must be ranked highest to lowest.
Real-time data can be hidden from the graph, but the date picker functionality must remain active.
